name: interface-method-implementations
description: An interface method no call site invokes through the interface is reported, and each method that implements it and that nothing else keeps is reported as well, as a member of the interface method's dead component, so the two delete together. The implementations of the method a call site invokes stay retained by the conversions, and an implementation a direct call reaches is reported under no code. A method that implements both the uncalled method and a method of a second interface that a call site invokes stays retained by the second interface's conversions.
